reply_text: @gideon.sato: You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel has no other guard activity until Mateo's 11:03 AM update: kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. I posted this as a reply in the channel.
